name: call-rounds-commit
description: Call Book v3: seal a round of calls for Cats you control (only the root goes on chain). Get the root, salt and reveal data from New Jazz City's MCP tool cat_call_plan, and keep them: reveal before the horizon or every call in the round is a forfeit.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: The round's Merkle root (cat_call_plan's leaf, for a one-call round).

inputs.name: tokenIds
inputs.description: The Cat for each call, in order.

inputs.name: horizon
inputs.description: Seconds until the calls are scored: 3600 to 2592000.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: 0 = PAPER (scored only). 1 = LIVE (also traded; you link the trade).
